title: e-CNY central bank digital currency
summary: China's retail central bank digital currency, in pilot since 2020.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

The e-CNY has been piloted across dozens of Chinese cities and used for retail payments, public subsidies and some cross-border tests. It is a liability of the central bank, designed for retail efficiency and state visibility rather than for wholesale settlement. Adoption remains modest relative to Alipay and WeChat Pay, which already solved retail payments.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Pilot
Estimated window 2020–2030
Confidence label Confident
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

The interesting question is not consumer adoption but whether CBDC rails change cross-border settlement costs.

What Would Change The View

  • Wallet volumes and active users.
  • mBridge governance and participating banks.
  • Merchant incentives beyond subsidies.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
